title: The Provider and Organization in Asthma Guidelines
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to examine the interaction between the personal attributes of clinicians and the organizations in which they work and the effect of interventions on their ability to implement an asthma disease management program. +
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Must have used Easy Breathing Disease Management Program for more than one year.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
